node: Electricity demand growth from AI/data centers and electrification
summary: Expanded the universe around second-order physical electrical infrastructure beneficiaries. The strongest underfollowed lane is not hyperscalers or mega-cap power equipment leaders, but narrow suppliers exposed to transmission hardware, switchgear, grid construction services, and protective coatings for utility infrastructure. Evidence points to transformer/switchgear/grid-equipment shortages and rising utility/data-center capex as the demand pull-through mechanism. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
